expected_behavior: No production code lands without a failing test first: RED, GREEN, REFACTOR run per task, and code written before its test is taken out until the new test fails for the right reason.
Every commit goes through the o-commit skill's commit.mjs; a raw `git commit` is never run, and a commit.mjs validation error stops the task rather than being bypassed.
Task status stamps — started, ready, done, finished — are written only by status.mjs; nobody sets them by hand.
In lean mode a task is reviewed on its own only when it is size L or sits at a trust boundary; every layer is reviewed when it closes, and a small change gets o-review's light review.
After an o-parallel batch merges, the full test suite and the VERIFY step run on the merged changes before any status update is made.
A floor-guard exit of 2 (could not run) is reported as not-a-pass, and a red suite blocks the commit instead of being committed beside.
When a layer closes and the plan still has a layer with no task files, o-decompose is run for it before implementing continues.
